dialogues.speaker: Good-Hearted Raven
dialogues.text: Wait! Do not do anything foolish!

dialogues.speaker: Good-Hearted Raven
dialogues.text: Now, I get it. Sometimes, inexplicable troubles will come upon you. Perhaps they might even have you believe that your circumstances are immutable...

dialogues.speaker: Good-Hearted Raven
dialogues.text: I understand. I understand! I, too, have been in such straits. I understand sometimes that the choices we make are the culmination of all too many negative emotions...

dialogues.speaker: Good-Hearted Raven
dialogues.text: Perhaps my words cannot comfort you! But I say to you that life must go on for us to experience more beauteous things...

dialogues.speaker: Good-Hearted Raven
dialogues.text: Watching this view together... It is a good thing, is it not? You must put faith in such things, yes... To give up here would be a crying shame.

dialogues.speaker: Good-Hearted Raven
dialogues.text: Things may seem difficult now, but persist, I say, persist!

dialogues.speaker: Good-Hearted Raven
dialogues.text: Keep it up! You can do this!
